text_block_list.name: Smiling People
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Oguri! You're a real
star!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(It's the same dream again... Not that I
mind. It
really is nice seeing everyone
smile.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's my day off and I've come to the
mountains to
do some hiking, but the
intermittent showers have
left the
ground slippery. While wondering

whether or not to turn back...

But we can't just stand here and let you
put
yourself at risk, ma'am.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for worrying about me, dearies,
but that
handkerchief was a gift from my
daughter.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
And besides, I was raised at the foot of
this
mountain—this whole area is
practically my
backyard!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like that hiker up ahead is in a
bit of
trouble. I look closer and see that
she's speaking
with a group of Tracen
Academy students.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They explain the situation and I learn
that they're
trying to stop the lady from
climbing the
mountain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
She forgot something at the summit and
wishes to
return to retrieve it. However...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The ascent is muddy and treacherous. It
was a
challenge even for us, and we're
no strangers to
rough terrain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're right. It'd definitely be
dangerous to try
going up this rugged
slope. I'm wondering if I
should chime in
and try dissuading the lady
myself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Would you mind if I took care of this?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll go up and look for it, so you can all
just wait
at the shrine at the base of the
mountain.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
But you've only just come down, haven't
you?
You must be tired.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. I'll be right back.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what speed! She almost reminds
me of...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We make our way down to the foot of
the
mountain and wait for Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...By the by, ma'am, I believe you were
about to
say something when you saw
Oguri Cap running
off?

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That I was. Seeing her dart off like
that
reminded me of the herald from the
old tales.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Are you perhaps referring to the divine
messenger
from the legend that's passed
down at this very
shrine?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In the story, when people found
themselves in
peril on this mountain, the
gods would dispatch
their herald upon a
whirlwind to help the troubled
souls.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's it! When I heard that story as
a child, I
tried picturing what that herald
might look like.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
I imagined she was extraordinarily
beautiful and
kind, and someone who
could run like the wind.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text: Yes, I imagined someone just like—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you all waiting.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Is this what you left behind?

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's it! I'm sure of it! Thank you so
much. I'll
have to find some way to repay
you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's fine. Please don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I had a dream this morning of a whole
bunch of
people smiling happily at me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So I suppose that's why I felt like I'd
rather see
happy faces than sad ones
today.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A divine message? For me?
choice_data_list: 神さまのお告げだったのかな？
人助けをしたんだから、もっと誇っていい
choice_data_list_en: You helped someone out, so you should be proud of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, a brisk breeze blows
through the
shrine grounds that leaves
me feeling strangely
satisfied and happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What a nice breeze. It feels so refreshing
after all
that running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Perhaps it's the gods thanking you
for your
efforts.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe. It'd be nice if that were
the case.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as Oguri Cap dreamt, everyone
ends the day
with bright smiles on their
faces.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, how fascinating. Oguri, do you
remember
anything else from that
dream?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, I feel like Tome was there
among
the crowd, and so was my
grandfather...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So you saw people you're close to? I
wonder if it's
because you're more likely
to be emotionally
swayed by them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the gods have hopes of their
own—ones
they're so eager to see
realized that they'd go so
far as to work
them into people's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hopes they want to see realized...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether her dream was a divine
message or not,
Oguri Cap has managed
to put smiles on people's
faces by
helping them out.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Seeing you take the initiative
and leap
into action served as a fine
lesson in
conduct—one I feel compelled
to learn from.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
You saved me such a lot of bother. I'll
have to
stop by Tracen Academy to
repay you sometime
in the future.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, really, you don't have to do that.
The extra
movement was good training
for me.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well then. In that case, I'll come
along to one
of your races and cheer you
on. I hope you'll run
just as beautifully
then as you did today.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You will? That's really kind of you. I'll do
my best
to put on a great performance
for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with that selfless act of
kindness, Oguri
Cap earns herself a new
fan.
